statusLine.command: input=$(cat); dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); cd "$dir" 2>/dev/null; base=$(basename "$dir"); b=$(git --no-optional-locks rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); printf '\033[37m%s\033[0m \033[32m➜\033[0m \033[36m%s\033[0m' "$(whoami)" "$base"; if [ -n "$b" ]; then printf ' \033[34mgit:(\033[31m%s\033[34m)\033[0m' "$b"; [ -n "$(git --no-optional-locks status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)" ] && printf ' \033[33m✗\033[0m'; fi
